title: loop verdict (verdict.json) — render-verdict/v0.5
description: v0.5 (round 4, artifact 95c071af @ 60d938df): NULL POLICY decided once — a present JSON null is never 'absent': null containers (openings/objects/apertures/furniture) are refused as malformed; a null object_bbox is an unreadable claim -> position_unverified. V04-1 key-presence bbox test; V04-2 no str() coercion on any category/kind/wall path (non-string render categories become display-only <unreadable-category:T> markers that can never match); V04-3 ap<i> regex anchored with \Z (trailing newline defeated $); V04-4 iter >= 0 enforced to match this schema. Consumer side of the render<->verdict seam. Canonical JSON (sorted keys, minimal separators, trailing LF); byte-identical re-runs required. discrepancy.score is exploratory and uncalibrated — never evidence. built_against echoes the packet contract_version consumed (fail-closed on mismatch). Breaking changes: version bump + _control ledger announcement BEFORE landing. v0.4 (round 3 + the properly versioned amendment): identity.mode and objects_mode are tri-state exact | multiset_fallback | vacuous; R3-1 — a target object bbox that is present but malformed, or mis-keyed as bbox_xywh, lands in position_unverified (symmetric with an unreadable render echo; a genuinely absent bbox owes nothing); R3-2 — target object id/category must be non-empty strings (refused otherwise), render furniture ids must be strings or the comparator degrades to multiset_fallback; no str() coercion in identity matching. v0.3: moved-object scoring via furniture id + _source_bbox echo; agreement_policy strict default; NaN refused (RFC 8259); manifest type-validated; strict ap<i> spelling. v0.2 (announced): identity block + per-opening matching via aperture ids; extra_aperture_frac component; malformed inputs refused exit 2.

items.description: v0.3 (Codex round-2 R2-1): furniture matched by source object id; _source_bbox (place_furniture.py:119) compared to the target object_bbox. Bound: x_m consistency with _source_bbox is platform math, not verified across the seam.

components.description: extra_aperture_frac added in v0.2 (Codex finding A2: invented apertures must cost).

identity.description: exact = per-opening matching via platform aperture ids ap<i>; multiset_fallback = ids absent, and any kind with >=2 target openings is unverifiable — a verdict with unverifiable kinds can never be BELOW_THRESHOLD (v0.2, Codex review finding A1). v0.3 amendment (pre-landing): 'vacuous' = nothing claimed on that axis by either side — verified by emptiness, allowed to agree, but never dressed up as 'exact'.

agreement_policy.description: strict (default): BELOW_THRESHOLD requires exact identity for openings AND objects with no position_unverified. allow_unverified: explicit relaxation for stub producers (v0.3).
